name: LNbits Holesail Proxy
description: Running Umbrel behind a home router (NAT) without a public domain? TOR is too slow? This app will allow you (and your friends) to connect remotely to your LNbits, using a Holesail - an instant P2P tunnel to bypass any network, firewall, NAT restrictions.
short_desc: A Holesail proxy to connect remotely to your LNbits
author: oren-z0
